title: Pullback of a classified section between nested opens
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], V ⊆ U two opens [def-weil-open-immersion], i : V → U their inclusion, F an abelian sheaf on the small étale site of X, and m : Z_U → j_U^*F a map from the constant ULift Z sheaf [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let b_W be the terminal étale object of W, v_W its image on X, rho_W : j_W^*F ≅ F restricted to W the specified localization comparison, and f : v_V → v_U the inclusion. Write sigma_W for the constant-sheaf adjunction followed by evaluation at 1, and c : j_V^* ≅ i^*j_U^* for the specified composition comparison [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. Then sigma_V(z_i^{-1} ≫ i^*(m) ≫ c_F^{-1}) = rho_V^{-1}(F(f)(rho_U(sigma_U(m)))). All terms are sections at b_V; the restriction F(f) is contravariant. This holds for every F and m, including empty and equal opens.

source.place: Lemma 21.7.1, localization restriction; explicit unit compatibility calculation of lem-weil-pbc-open-restriction-pullback-unit, specialized to nested opens.

proof.text: Expand z_i as leftAdjointUniq between the composite of the constant-sheaf adjunction with the inverse-image adjunction and the constant-sheaf adjunction on V. Its inverse changes adjunctions without changing the adjoint map. Thus sigma_V of the displayed composite is obtained from sigma_U(m) by the inverse-image unit for i, evaluation on the terminal pullback, and then c_F inverse. Naturality moves m through this calculation.

Use the open restriction pullback unit calculation for g = U.ι and W = V. Identify V times_X U with V using V ≤ U and monomorphy of U.ι. The map i is the resulting restricted projection. The identity pullback unit cancels its identity comparison; the composition unit equation leaves c_F inverse followed by the V localization comparison. Consequently the section map of the first step, followed by rho_V, is rho_U followed by F(f).

Cancel rho_V and evaluate the equality of group homomorphisms on sigma_U(m). Naturality of rho_U identifies the source expression and gives the asserted formula. Terminal object uniqueness treats equal opens; none of the identifications uses nonemptiness, so the empty open also satisfies the formula.

theorem etaleOpenSection_pullback {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (U V : X.Opens) (h : V ≤ U)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (m : (constantSheaf U.toScheme.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ)) ⟶
      (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} U.ι).obj F) :
    let bU := Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 U.toScheme)
    let bV := Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 V.toScheme)
    let vU := (MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ (inferInstance : Etale U.ι)).obj bU
    let vV := (MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ (inferInstance : Etale V.ι)).obj bV
    let f : vV ⟶ vU := MorphismProperty.Over.homMk (X.homOfLE h)
      (by
        change X.homOfLE h ≫ (𝟙 U.toScheme ≫ U.ι) = 𝟙 V.toScheme ≫ V.ι
        simpa only [Category.id_comp] using X.homOfLE_ι h) trivial
    AddCommGrpCat.uliftZMultiplesAddEquiv _
      ((constantSheafAdj V.toScheme.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (show IsTerminal bV from IsTerminal.ofUniqueHom
          (fun a ↦ MorphismProperty.Over.homMk a.hom (Category.comp_id _))
          (fun a f ↦ by
            apply MorphismProperty.Over.Hom.ext
            exact (Category.comp_id _).symm.trans (MorphismProperty.Over.w f)))).homEquiv _ _
        ((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (X.homOfLE h)).inv.app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ)) ≫
          (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (X.homOfLE h)).map m ≫
          (Etale.upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (X.homOfLE h) U.ι V.ι
            (X.homOfLE_ι h).symm).inv.app F)) =
      (((Etale.upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} V.ι
        inferInstance).inv.app F).hom.app (op bV))
        (F.obj.map f.op
          ((((Etale.upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} U.ι
            inferInstance).hom.app F).hom.app (op bU))
            (AddCommGrpCat.uliftZMultiplesAddEquiv _
              ((constantSheafAdj U.toScheme.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
                (show IsTerminal bU from IsTerminal.ofUniqueHom
                  (fun a ↦ MorphismProperty.Over.homMk a.hom (Category.comp_id _))
                  (fun a f ↦ by
                    apply MorphismProperty.Over.Hom.ext
                    exact (Category.comp_id _).symm.trans
                      (MorphismProperty.Over.w f)))).homEquiv _ _ m))))
